provenance: PaGleba curated feature definitions; MetaCyc pathway IDs from the user-supplied MACADAM snapshot; not a bundled database

auxin_IAA_biosynthesis.note: Excludes indole production, IAA degradation, conjugation and inactivation.

gibberellin_biosynthesis.note: GA12-only precursor pathway is excluded; pathway annotation does not prove hormone secretion or plant response.

gibberellin_GA12_precursor.note: Precursor only, separate from downstream gibberellin biosynthesis.

ethylene_biosynthesis.note: Excludes ethylene glycol degradation and engineered pathways.

abscisic_acid_biosynthesis.note: Specific ABA pathway; excludes abscisate degradation and broad derivative classes.

salicylate_biosynthesis.note: Salicylate production potential, not proof of hormonal signaling or induced plant resistance.

proteolysis.note: No specific extracellular protease pathway/EC in this snapshot; use positive IJSEM gelatinase observations, not housekeeping peptidases.

cellulolysis.note: Polymer cleavage; excludes cellulose biosynthesis and cellobiose utilization alone.

chitinolysis.note: Excludes chitin biosynthesis and degradation of monomeric chitin derivatives alone.

lipolysis.note: Triacylglycerol degradation; no general esterase or lipid biosynthesis surrogate.

siderophore_biosynthesis.note: Curated MetaCyc Siderophores-Biosynthesis hierarchy; includes pyoverdine variants, desferrioxamines, pyochelin and other named siderophores; excludes uptake, transport, storage and degradation.

CO2_fixation_autotrophic.note: Complete autotrophic cycles only; excludes incomplete reductive TCA and anaplerotic carboxylation.

CO2_anaplerotic_carboxylation.note: Separate from net autotrophic CO2 fixation.

phosphate_solubilization_inorganic.note: Not inferred from generic acid production, phosphate transport or phosphatases.

organic_P_mineralization_phosphatase.note: Positive acid/alkaline phosphatase phenotype only; excludes housekeeping NAD phosphatases and mineral phosphate solubilization.

ACC_deaminase.note: Requires explicit ACC deaminase; not inferred from ethylene synthesis.

butanediol_biosynthesis.note: All annotated stereoisomer routes; excludes butanediol degradation.

EPS_matrix_polysaccharides.note: Alginate/cellulose biosynthesis potential; not direct proof of secretion or biofilm formation.

biofilm_formation.note: No direct biofilm phenotype annotation in these sources; EPS precursor pathways are not substituted.

antagonistic_secondary_metabolites.note: Selected known antibiotic biosynthetic routes; no direct proof of pathogen suppression in the sample.

aromatic_compound_degradation.note: Source FAPROTAX ecological annotation, not a sum of nonspecific aromatic intermediates.

plant_pathogenic_potential.note: FAPROTAX annotation; selected activities are not necessarily beneficial to plants.
